## Introduction

In this course we covered how algorithms are described and controlled. This page includes practice problems on problem statements, control flow and step numbering, flowchart blocks, and the kinds of repetition.

## How To Use This Page

For each problem, use the **↻ New variant** button to generate a new problem of that type. Use the **Check** button to check your answer. Use the **Show answer** button to see the answer and an explanation.

[Review the lesson](../../lessons/01%20Introduction%20to%20Algorithms/index.qmd){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
